explication: RED HAWK is a command-line information-gathering and vulnerability-scanning tool. The user starts the PHP CLI, enters a target and selects a scan; the main script dispatches the selected scan and prints results. Its documented scan families include site profiling, network and DNS lookups, crawling, WordPress checks, and SQLi scanning. Shared PHP functions implement detection and lookup helpers, while configuration supplies optional Moz credentials for Bloggers View. Some scan implementations are not excerpted, so their individual internal calls are not inferred.
